donations.title: How donations are used
donations.intro: Donations support ADA’s nonprofit work in these areas. ADA reports what it spends on its {form990}.
donations.certificationValue: Multilingual exam development, examiner training, upkeep of the training curriculum and the public verification registry.
donations.scholarshipsValue: Need-based grants toward exam and training fees for doulas from underserved Asian communities.
donations.communityValue: Workshops, family education events, partner outreach and translated postpartum care materials.
donations.administrationValue: Technology, accounting, legal and insurance. Directors are volunteers and are not paid.
donations.privacyValue: ADA never sells or shares donor lists with other organizations.

accountability.title: Accountability
accountability.review: An independent review of finances and program outcomes every year
accountability.form990: A public {form990} every year, starting with fiscal year {year}
accountability.board: A volunteer board of directors: no director receives compensation
accountability.coi: A written conflict of interest policy, reviewed every year
